metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Dr. Mara Round
records.biography_en: In The Circle With One Extra Chair, Dr. Mara Round takes the role of attentive group facilitator. “We have time for one more voice.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small egg timer and open palm gesture.

records.name: Drew Turnyet
records.biography_en: In The Circle With One Extra Chair, Drew Turnyet takes the role of eager participant learning to wait. “I can wait. Is it now?”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: simple padded talking token pressed to belly.

records.name: Gordon Firstword
records.biography_en: In The Circle With One Extra Chair, Gordon Firstword takes the role of hesitant newcomer. “I wrote the first sentence.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small folded note held between two goo hands.

records.name: Tess Boundaries
records.biography_en: In The Circle With One Extra Chair, Tess Boundaries takes the role of determined boundary setter. “This is where I need space.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short soft knitted ribbon stretched just in front of body.

records.name: Alf Longpause
records.biography_en: In The Circle With One Extra Chair, Alf Longpause takes the role of weary listener who has found a quiet moment. “I liked the quiet bit.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny plain tea mug with a simple smooth handle.

records.name: Cobb Checklist
records.biography_en: In The Circle With One Extra Chair, Cobb Checklist takes the role of earnest intake administrator. “There is a box for that.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: thick plain clipboard with large blank checkboxes.
